reviews.title: An absolutely wonderful gaming mouse!
reviews.comment: The Corsair M75 Wireless RGB Lightweight FPS Gaming Mouse is absolutely perfect and it just works. Not the lightest weight gaming mouse, but I actually find the lightweight ones (<60 grams) are too light. I actually prefer this medium weight one. It is very well built and everything works including the scroll wheel (looking at you Razer Viper V2 Pro). I also enjoy having the RGB lighting as it is a quick way to tell if the mouse is turned on or off. I don't use it for looks really, but instead feedback. Really good shape and is comfortable for my finger grip and medium size hands. I was worried about the swappable magnetic buttons falling off as I typically transport my mouse with my laptop in my backpack, but it is a non-issue as they stay attached very well. I had some prior experience with another Corsair mouse which had a magnetic piece and it never came off, so I took a chance on this one. I am not the biggest fan of iCUE software as it is not very intuitive to use, but it does get the job done. Razer's software is definitely more intuitive, but they cannot get their scroll wheels to work. Corsair has definitely impressed me with their products from keyboards to mice.

reviews.title: great mouse if you use MMB press and hold for 3D and CAD applications.
reviews.comment:
Hard to find a middle mouse button (MMB) that is sensitive and easy to depress. that's an important feature for me because my software demands thousands of MMB presses and holds every day.
good battery life and comfortable in my hand. I'm a Lefty so this mouse is a gold star find.
will probably buy another just to have as a backup in case they stop making these in the near future.
CONS:
side buttons are a bit clunky to use, switch, customize, and overall press is too 'jiggly'. Not a big deal for me since i only use 2 side buttons for FWD/BACK when surfin'.  Something to consider though.
Big issue I have is no "low battery" indicator. Small icon in system tray but can't really notice it.  would love a "pop up" option in windows or even flashing lights on the mouse, but might not be able to see it.
I have to plug in a UCB-C to continue to use it. Kind of a pain but I just have to remember to plug in once or twice a week when i go to bed.

reviews.title: Super light and nice
reviews.comment:
Great connectivity, love the colors even though you cant see them when holding it. The (optional use) cord is great because it doesn't change the feel much and cuts down on response time and allows for icue to do some fun patterns with the rest of your corsair gear.
It is a bit small for my hands but as long as your hands aren't bigger than a large size glove it should be useable.
